description:
A new way to collaborate

Empowering teams by messenger, meetings, calendar, docs, and emails. It's all in one place.
Base
- Base now supports 10 new formula functions: SMALL, LARGE, LET, SQRT, LOG, LN, EXP, PRODUCT, STDEV, and RANDOMARRAY. You can use them to retrieve the k-th smallest or largest value in an array, reuse intermediate variables, perform square root and logarithm calculations, compute products and sample standard deviations, generate random arrays, and more.
- You can configure settings in form view of Base to automatically notify recipients whenever someone submits a response, making it easy to track submissions in real time. You can also schedule reminders to follow up on progress with less effort.
- You can add a signature field in Base to allow users to sign either by hand or by typing their name, helping your team keep a reliable audit trail. It can be used in a wide range of scenarios, such as approval confirmations, store inspections, acceptance checks, training check-ins, meeting check-ins, and so much more.
